links.outcome: Patient-rated simplicity and comprehensibility of AI-simplified versus radiologist-written breast imaging reports
links.effect: High simplicity and comprehensibility scores (4-5) were assigned to AI reports more often than to radiologist reports (70.0% vs 43.4% and 68.1% vs 40.4%). AI reports were preferred in 63.3% (1876/2965) of evaluations.
links.quote: High simplicity and comprehensibility scores (4-5) were more frequently assigned to AI reports than to radiologist-written reports (70.0% vs 43.4% and 68.1% vs 40.4%, respectively).

screen.reason: Prospective multi-center reader/survey study evaluating patient perceptions and preference between LLM-simplified vs. radiologist-simplified breast imaging reports. It does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
